title: Claim
description: One atomic, checkable statement taken from a piece of copy.

claim_id.description: Run-local ID such as R-20261023-0001. The ledger assigns permanent IDs.

text.description: The claim as a single declarative sentence, keeping the original wording where it matters (always for quotes).

context.description: The sentence or caption the claim came from, verbatim.

location.description: Where the claim lives: URL plus section, node ID, file path, or image filename.

risk.description: High for quotes, superlatives, image IDs, family facts and anything bound for /tr, exhibits, quizzes, press releases or datasets.

routing.description: Specialist skill names chosen by the coordinator.
